{{Recipe summary
| Category = Soup recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

This recipe first appeared in a Collection of Recipes by Chef Taylor Piercefield. Chef Piercefield also made variations of this soup with Morel Mushrooms.

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (950 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Duck Stock|duck stock]]
* 3 duck [[cookbook:Egg yolk|egg yolk]]s (chicken egg yolks will work too)
* 2 cups (480 ml) [[cookbook:milk|milk]] or [[cookbook:Half and Half|half and half]]
* ½ cup (120 ml) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[cookbook:duck|duck]] meat
* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (225 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[cookbook:mushroom|mushroom]]s
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:thyme|thyme]]
* [[cookbook:nutmeg|nutmeg]] to taste (optional)

== Procedure ==
# Heat duck stock in a heavy, covered [[cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]] over medium heat.
# Add thyme, chopped duck meat, and mushrooms, and cook until mushrooms are tender.
# In a [[cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]], [[cookbook:whisk|whisk]] egg yolks and milk until well-blended, then slowly add to soup.
# Stir continually until soup mixture begins to thicken.  
# Sprinkle in nutmeg and serve.
